name: MacroBioBoi
noteEs: MacroBioBoi es el specialist de Necromancer y Warlock en D4 — su content cubre extensively esas dos clases con builds detallados, speed farming variants y patch reactions específicos. Tambén postea D2R content como crossover. Si juegas Necromancer en D4, su channel es de los más completos para la clase. Asociado con Maxroll team — sus guides aparecen integrated.
noteEn: MacroBioBoi is the Necromancer and Warlock specialist in D4 — his content covers those two classes extensively with detailed builds, speed-farming variants, and class-specific patch reactions. Also posts D2R content as crossover. If you play Necromancer in D4, his channel is among the most complete for the class. Associated with the Maxroll team — his guides appear integrated.
